Hi Alex —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short implementation plan so your infra and platform teams have visibility on how we’ll seed projects, create API keys, and invite users. Attached is a lightweight "Project Seed" template we use to capture project names, owners, and the minimal role map for each environment (dev/stage/prod).

High level proposal (first 10 business days):
- Day 0: Kickoff (45–60m) with platform + infra engineers to confirm naming and network/VPC details.
- Day 1–3: Create 2 sandbox projects + 1 staging project; seed API keys for a service account and 2 test users.
- Day 4–7: Validate requests against expected token/latency profiles; adjust batching/kv cache as needed.
- Day 8–10: Promote staging config; invite first group of product users and CS.

Please review the attached template and the IAM role matrix I’m sending in a follow-up. Can you confirm who on your side should be invited as project owners (email) and whether procurement needs a separate cadence for API key delivery?

Proposed kickoff times (PST): Wed 7/9 10:00am, Wed 7/9 3:00pm, Thu 7/10 9:00am — I’ll send an invite once you confirm a slot.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Alex —

Great — 7/9 10:00am confirmed. For your questions:

Naming & key strategy (short answers):
- Project IDs: rwi-medsyn-{env}-{team} (e.g., rwi-medsyn-dev-platform). Keeps cost and routing tags consistent.
- API keys: we recommend one service account key per service per env (so you can rotate independently) + short-lived test-user keys for manual testing.
- Key IDs: rwi-{project}-{purpose}-{yyyyMM}, e.g., rwi-medsyn-dev-platform-svc-202507.

Procurement checklist (high level):
- Ensure keys are only delivered over your secure secrets store (HashiCorp Vault / AWS Secrets Manager).
- Verify HSM/KMS policies for production service accounts (we support KMS-wrapped keys).
- Agree on rotation windows (recommended 90 days for non-prod, 30 days for prod).

Attached: IAM_Role_Matrix.csv and a short Redwood Org Checklist PDF that maps each action to ownership. Below is a quick mutual action plan we can finalize on the call:

Mutual action plan (editable on call):
- Owner: Medsyn infra (Daniel) — confirm project names + cost center tags (by EOD 7/11)
- Owner: Redwood (Ben) — create projects, seed keys, provide example get-token calls (by 7/10)
- Owner: Medsyn product — provide list of early invitees for dev/stage (by 7/12)
- Owner: Procurement (Medsyn) — accept key handling checklist and sign-off (by 7/15)
- Owner: CS/PM — schedule handover review and performance check (7/16)

Ben will be the implementation lead from our side and will share the exact seed commands. Monica will handle the invite cadence and rollout comms.

See you at 10am. I’ll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda and the call link.

Best,
Lauren

On Wed, Jul 9, 2025 at 11:45 AM lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben will be the implementation lead from our side and will share the exact seed commands.

Folks — posting the minimal commands we’ll run during the seed. These assume you’ve agreed on project IDs and that Medsyn has provided an admin user to accept invites. Replace placeholders before running:

1) Create project (Redwood console CLI):
  rwi project create --id rwi-medsyn-dev-platform --owner alex.rivera@medsyn.com --region us-west-2

2) Seed service account key:
  rwi keys create --project rwi-medsyn-dev-platform --name rwi-medsyn-dev-platform-svc-202507 --type service --kms ksm://medsyn-kms-key

3) Create short-lived test user key (30m):
  rwi keys create --project rwi-medsyn-dev-platform --name rwi-medsyn-dev-test-30m --type user --ttl 30m

4) Invite users (via console): owner, infra, product; roles per IAM_Role_Matrix.csv

Notes:
- We recommend creating a separate service account for any high-volume background job to avoid noisy metrics in another team's usage.
- If Medsyn wants us to pre-seed API keys into your Vault, we can provide an encrypted payload for Vault import (need a public key from your Vault team).

Link to internal docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMedsynOnboarding (contains seed script and test harness).

– Dev Patel
Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference
